description: This file defines the DUEL templating engine, including type definitions, binding logic, rendering functions, and DOM manipulation methods. It provides mechanisms for template compilation, data binding, and rendering HTML or DOM nodes.

classes.name: Markup
classes.description: Wraps a string value to maintain as raw markup in output, with a toString method for rendering.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Represents a binding result, capable of rendering itself as HTML or DOM, and supporting reload into the document.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a child node to a parent node, handling different types such as arrays, objects, and primitives.

methods.name: bindContent
methods.description: Binds a template node to data, producing a fragment or value.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Handles iteration over arrays or objects for template binding.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Processes conditional template blocks based on a test.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Invokes another view/template with data context.

methods.name: part
methods.description: Replaces a placeholder part with a named partial view.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Main binding function that processes different template command tags and literals.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a view tree into an HTML string.

methods.name: toDOM
methods.description: Converts a view tree into DOM nodes, optionally replacing or merging into an existing element.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Replaces the entire document with the current Result's DOM.
